get.description:
Return a side-by-side comparison of runs ``a`` and ``b``.

The payload shape is geared toward a diff UI:

* ``a``/``b`` — each side's ``runs`` row (with parsed ``metrics``).
* ``days`` — ``day.completed`` payloads aligned by ``trading_day``;
  missing sides surface as ``None``.
* ``decisions`` — decision records aligned by ``seq``; missing sides
  surface as ``None``.

Returns RFC 7807 404 if *either* run id is unknown.

get.description:
Stream persisted + live events for ``run_id`` as SSE.

Honors the ``Last-Event-ID`` header for resumable clients: rows with
``id > last_event_id`` are replayed from SQLite, then the handler
switches to the in-process pubsub for live fanout.  Heartbeat frames
are emitted during idle periods so proxies don't close the socket.

the unified run-detail view to populate the events panel after a run
finishes.

get.description:
Return the caller's identity + ``can_launch`` flag.

Clerk is currently invite-only, so any authenticated session is
allowed to launch. The auth signal is ``X-Actor-User`` (Clerk
userId) — NOT ``X-Actor-Email``, because Clerk doesn't put email
into the session JWT by default. If the SSR proxy managed to
resolve an email (via session claims or future backend lookup) we
surface it for display; otherwise it's empty. ``can_launch`` is
tied strictly to ``user_id`` presence.

``LAUNCH_ALLOWLIST`` is retained as second-gate infrastructure in
case Clerk registration opens later.

post.description:
Promote a decision to a checkpoint.

Returns ``{"id": <checkpoint_id>, "status": "ready"}`` with HTTP
201 on success.  See :mod:`liveoption_web.checkpoint.promote` for
the crash-safe artifact + transaction protocol.

Error shapes (all RFC 7807):

* 403 — missing or wrong ``X-Internal-Secret`` (from dependency).
* 404 — ``type=decision-not-found``.
* 409 — ``type=already-promoted``.

call.

EventHistoryItem.description: Single event row returned by the history endpoint.

EventHistoryPage.title: EventHistoryPage
EventHistoryPage.description:
Cursor-paginated page of events for a run.

``events`` is newest-first by ``events.id`` desc. ``total`` counts every
event for ``run_id`` independent of pagination. ``truncated`` is True iff
older events exist beyond this page; ``next_cursor`` is non-null iff
truncated and equals ``min(events.id)`` (the last/oldest event's id).

Body of ``POST /v1/runs``.

Phase C: ``overrides`` is parsed as a raw dict here so the handler can
re-validate it against the scenario's family-specific Pydantic model

before any side effects.
